verdict.rationale: The Airwallex CLI is explicitly documented for headless/scripted use — "script repeatable tasks, and wire Airwallex into automated systems" — with sandbox-by-default and --prod opt-in, and its installer script was independently probed and confirmed live. Combined with the full REST API and webhooks (both naturally CI/automation-friendly and used to power AgentOS workflows), this supports running Airwallex integrations headlessly in CI. Missing for 10: an explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions integration) and independent community reports of using the CLI/API in real CI setups.
